en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand multi‑story hotel building labeled "HOTEL DE SAXE" in a spa town setting. In front of the hotel are trees, small pavilion tents, a decorative fenced terrace, and a richly ornamented half‑timbered structure. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll and stand along the street in the foreground. Printed captions identify the location and publisher/date.
